subject: general
question: Yamini Krishna Murti is a dancer of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy **was a classical Indian dancer who performed Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi**
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy **was a prominent dancer in India for decades**.
 
• She was born in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh on December 20, 1940 and died in New Delhi on August 3, 2024. 
 
• She was a recipient of the **Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan awards. **
 
• She also received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1977**
